canonical_full_method_seconds_per_slice.scope: NewMetric preprocessing, canonical candidate generation, and label-free selection; retrospective oracle evaluation occurred after the elapsed-time interval
canonical_full_method_seconds_per_slice.concurrency_note: The historical batch script supports parallel workers, but the worker count used for these archived case-level timings was not stored in provenance; these values are descriptive batch timings, not standardized serial inference latency.

expanded_budget_additional_seconds_per_s.scope: Serial preprocessing plus additional standard-seed and fuzzy alpha-cut candidates through 30 seeds per window and 39 nested alpha levels; frozen canonical pool loading is excluded

interpretation: The two measurements have different scopes and must not be added as if obtained in one end-to-end timing pass.
